findings.description: Successful unlocking dispels a fear becomes temporarily pushing thoughts aside.

contexts.japanese:
この部屋に俺を閉じ込めた悪魔が、
もうすぐ出られると思わせて絶望させようと企む罠かもしれないという妄想は、
……今、払われた。
contexts.japanesePC:
この部屋に俺を閉じ込めた悪魔が、もうすぐ出られると思わせて絶望させようと企む罠かもしれないという妄想は、
......今、払われた。
contexts.japanesePS3:
この部屋に俺を閉じ込めた悪魔が、
もうすぐ出られると思わせて絶望させようと企む罠かもしれないという妄想は、
……今、払われた。
contexts.WH:
I had a vision of the demon who had locked me in this room using this as a trap to give me hope and then make me despair even more,
......but I pushed those thoughts aside for the time being.
contexts.UP:
At that moment, that terrible thought,
that the demon who had locked me in this room might have been using this as a trap to give me hope and then make me despair even more,
......finally stopped haunting me.

MG.japanese: カチャリ……。この部屋に俺を閉じ込めた悪魔が、もうすぐ出られると思わせて絶望させようと企む罠かもしれないという妄想は、……今、払われた。
MG.translation: *clank*... I imagined the demon who'd locked me in this room using this as a trap to give me hope, just to make me despair even more, ...but I pushed those thoughts aside for the time being.

UP.japanese: カチャリ……。この部屋に俺を閉じ込めた悪魔が、もうすぐ出られると思わせて絶望させようと企む罠かもしれないという妄想は、……今、払われた。
UP.translation: Clink...... At that moment, that terrible thought, that the demon who had locked me in this room might have been using this as a trap to give me hope and then make me despair even more, ......finally stopped haunting me.

findings.sourceReading: The delusion that unlocking might be a trap is now dispelled, immediately after the successful clank and before the visibly dangling unlocked chain.
findings.alternative: Pushed those thoughts aside for the time being describes deliberate provisional dismissal, whereas the passive 払われた reports the fear being dispelled at this moment. Later renewed torment does not make this earlier reaction provisional in the source.

findings.description: Joining merely out of social obligation becomes passing time.

contexts.japanese: これまでの嘉音だったら、このトランプは、ただの付き合いに過ぎない。
contexts.japanesePC: これまでの嘉音だったら、このトランプは、ただの付き合いに過ぎない。
contexts.japanesePS3: これまでの嘉音だったら、このトランプは、ただの付き合いに過ぎない。
contexts.WH: The old Kanon would only have seen this card game as a way to pass the time.
contexts.MG: The old Kanon would only have seen this card game as a way to pass the time.
contexts.UP: The old Kanon would only have seen this card game as a way to pass the time.

MG.japanese:
これまでの嘉音だったら、このトランプは、ただの付き合いに過ぎない。しかし、……今の嘉音は、そこからも、何かを得ることが出来るようになっていた。それを多分、成長と呼ぶ。
家具は、時を経ても朽ちていくだけだ。成長できるのは、……ニンゲンだけの特権なのだ。
MG.translation: The old Kanon would only have seen this card game as a way to pass the time. However, ...the new Kanon was now capable of gaining something new from this experience. That's probably...what it means to grow. Furniture does nothing but rot with the passage of time. The ability to grow...is a privilege given only to Humans.

UP.japanese:
これまでの嘉音だったら、このトランプは、ただの付き合いに過ぎない。しかし、……今の嘉音は、そこからも、何かを得ることが出来るようになっていた。それを多分、成長と呼ぶ。
家具は、時を経ても朽ちていくだけだ。成長できるのは、……ニンゲンだけの特権なのだ。
UP.translation:
The old Kanon would only have seen this card game as a way to pass the time. However, ......the new Kanon was now capable of gaining something new from this experience. That could probably be called...growth.
Furniture does nothing but rot with the passage of time. Being able to grow......is a privilege given only to Humanhumans.

findings.sourceReading: ただの付き合い means participating merely to accommodate or keep company with others, contrasted with learning something from the experience.
findings.alternative: Passing time also suggests lack of personal investment, but assigns idle entertainment rather than participation for others' sake.

findings.description: Refreshing acceptance of an earnest loss becomes indifference to losing.

UP.translation: Visiting a shrine before an important exam to pray that you'll pass is something that many people do. However, not many people will actually credit that visit as the reason for their success. Praying like this contains no power except as a calming influence.

MG.japanese: 「現に紗音はかつて、譲治お兄ちゃんとの出会いのきっかけを作ったのはブローチのお陰だけど、それ以降は魔法の力を借りずに関係を深めたいと言って、ベアトにブローチを返そうとさえしたわ。彼女はその時点で、一度は魔法の奇跡と決別したはず。……なのになぜ再び、その力を必要としているの？」
MG.translation: "It's true that the brooch gave Shannon the chance she needed to get together with George onii-chan, but some time after that, she said she wanted to deepen their relationship without borrowing the power of magic, and she even tried to give the brooch back to Beato. At that point, she supposedly rejected the miracle of magic for a time. ...So, why would that power be necessary again?"

UP.japanese: 「現に紗音はかつて、譲治お兄ちゃんとの出会いのきっかけを作ったのはブローチのお陰だけど、それ以降は魔法の力を借りずに関係を深めたいと言って、ベアトにブローチを返そうとさえしたわ。彼女はその時点で、一度は魔法の奇跡と決別したはず。……なのになぜ再び、その力を必要としているの？」
UP.translation: "It's true that the brooch gave Shannon the chance she needed to get together with George onii‐chan, but after that, she said she wanted to deepen their relationship without borrowing the power of magic, and she even tried to give the brooch back to Beato. She put the miracle of magic behind her at that point. ......In that case, why is she once again in need of its power?"

findings.sourceReading: JP 決別したはず gives Ange’s inference. OriginalPC76821/76823 and MG retain supposedly; UP states She put the miracle of magic behind her as an unqualified event.
findings.alternative: The prior account strongly supports the inference, but it does not remove the explicitly inferential wording.
findings.sourceNote: Original Witch Hunt is compared with the original-PC Japanese embedded in the historical patches. MangaGamer uses the accepted MangaGamer-based Witch Hunt backport, and Umineko Project uses its repository English; both are compared with maintained PS3-derived Japanese. The MangaGamer and PS3 witnesses are not independently certified retail extractions.
